description: Closed CouncilFlow skill-level contract; not JSON Schema or ACP Supervisor transport.
limits: Structural checks do not authenticate senders or enforce native transport.
Provide externally observed identity and ordered context for causal/origin checks.
Use root to verify artifact bytes, not merely hash syntax.

conditional_fields.worker.job.report: candidate_ref is output; input_candidate_ref echoes assigned input if supplied
conditional_fields.tester.job.report: candidate_ref and oracle_ref exactly echo Manager assignment; passed status requires passed mandatory checks. Optional deterministic_commands records include command/arguments, workdir, candidate/input identity hashes, exit code, SHA-256 of stdout after CRLF-to-LF replacement only, acceptance criterion and evidence artifact.
conditional_fields.reviewer.job.report: comparison binds original plan, Worker candidate and Tester report evidence. independent_rerun records one selected Tester command, exact matching conditions, its own exit/hash/evidence, and comparison to Tester result. MATCH requires equal exit and normalized stdout hash; MISMATCH cannot pass; NOT_COMPARABLE cannot satisfy E8.
conditional_fields.job.report.changed_files: Required for Worker and optional for other roles; always a bounded string array, never authority to edit product code.
conditional_fields.task.decision.failed_acceptance_ids: Only valid assigned/original criterion identities; accept cannot contain a nonempty failure list.
conditional_fields.plan.check.results: Every passed criterion requires explicit nonempty evidence_refs; structural citations do not prove evidence semantics.
conditional_fields.plan.publish.plan_ref: With root context: JSON object containing matching typed plan_id, positive nonboolean integer plan_revision, and nonempty acceptance objects with unique id strings; criterion text validated when present.
conditional_fields.message.created_at: Agent-authored messages omit created_at. Diagnostic created_at syntax validation does not prove trusted clock provenance.
